user_query: My company is organizing a charity event and we need to send SMS invitations to potential donors. Please check if the SMSAPI.com service is authorized and available. Additionally, fetch the contacts from the Maytapi WhatsApp and provide me with a random message from the 'birthday' category.

TaskList.description: Check the authorization status and availability of the SMSAPI.com service.
Fetch contacts from the Maytapi WhatsApp service.
Retrieve a random message from the 'birthday' category.
Send SMS invitations to the fetched contacts using the message from the 'birthday' category.
